title: Common providers: Philippines
coverage: Partial. Covers the national carriers, the three mobile network operators, the main fibre and cable providers, two business ISPs, the research network and the common satellite service.
missing: The regulator's operator register (the NTC site refused an automated check on the read date)
Provincial cable operators and regional ISPs
Websites for Smart, Globe, Sky and PREGINET (none gave a normal answer to an automated check on the read date)
Status pages (none was found that answered a check)

sources.name: NTC (National Telecommunications Commission)
sources.terms: The site refused an automated check on the read date, so its terms were not read and nothing is taken.
sources.result: Did not answer (HTTP 403). It is the authority to consult for operators this pack lacks.

sources.name: Wikipedia: Internet in the Philippines and Telecommunications in the Philippines
sources.terms: CC BY-SA 4.0. Used to cross-check names and ownership (facts); no text is copied.
sources.result: 9 of 10 names were found on the pages.

sources.name: Each provider's own public website
sources.terms: Only the address itself is recorded (a fact); no content is copied.
sources.result: 6 of 10 websites and 1 business, support or status pages answered an automated check; an address that did not answer is left empty.

sources.name: RIPEstat as-overview (RIPE NCC)
sources.terms: The RIPEstat service terms were read on the read date; RIPEstat data is not redistributed: nothing is copied. Consulted to confirm, for each AS number, the registered holder and that the number is announced.
sources.result: 15 AS numbers confirmed; a number whose registered holder was another company, or that was not announced on the read date, was left out.

sources.name: NRO delegated statistics (the regional registries' joint list of assigned AS numbers)
sources.terms: Published by the registries for public use; only which registry holds each AS number is taken (a fact).
sources.result: Every AS number in the pack was found in the list; its registry is recorded beside it.

sources.name: Wikidata
sources.terms: CC0 1.0: no conditions. The item id of a provider is recorded as a stable cross-reference.
sources.result: 1 entries carry the id of their own Wikidata item; each item states one of the entry's AS numbers (property P3797). A parent group's item is not used.

sources.name: PeeringDB
sources.terms: The acceptable use policy forbids reproducing PeeringDB data outside approved operational purposes: nothing is copied; cited as a place to look up an AS number.

providers.name: PLDT
providers.notes: The support address is the business site.

providers.name: Smart
providers.notes: Mobile; part of the PLDT group. Its website gave no normal answer to an automated check on the read date.

providers.name: Globe
providers.notes: Mobile and fixed. Its website refused an automated check on the read date.

providers.name: Converge
providers.notes: Fibre. AS56207 is registered to ComClark Network & Technology.

providers.name: Sky Cable
providers.notes: Cable. No website answered an automated check on the read date.

providers.name: PREGINET
aka: Philippine Research, Education and Government Information Network
providers.notes: The AS number is registered to the Department of Science and Technology. No website answered.

providers.name: Starlink
providers.notes: Satellite; also in the international pack under the same AS number.
